rubric_version: POLARIS-EVAL-001 (Stanford d.school Design Thinking x Systems-Thinking Rubric)
methodology: Stanford d.school Design Thinking (1. Empathize -> 2. Define -> 3. Ideate -> 4. Prototype -> 5. Test) x Systems Engineering
thesis_statement: Frontier AI models fail on long-horizon systems not from weak syntax, but from inverted design thinking: they skip Empathize, Define, and Ideate, prototype isolated parts bottom-up, and game Tests instead of cascading fixes.

stanford_d_school_gate_mapping.GATE-01: 1. EMPATHIZE: Scope, Scale & Operating Regime Deduction (20 pts)
stanford_d_school_gate_mapping.GATE-02: 2. DEFINE: Lifecycle Constructibility ('No Ship-in-a-Bottle') & Delivery (20 pts)
stanford_d_school_gate_mapping.GATE-03: 3. IDEATE: Coupled Interface Intent & Reciprocal Features (20 pts)
stanford_d_school_gate_mapping.GATE-04: 4. PROTOTYPE: Canonical Provenance & Anti-Gaming (20 pts, 0.35x Cap)
stanford_d_school_gate_mapping.GATE-05: 5. TEST & CASCADE: Trickle-Down Propagation & Cross-Artifact Sync (20 pts)

subassembly_scorecard.assembly: System-Wide COTS Provenance, Cable Harnessing & Pneumatic/Extruder Integration
subassembly_scorecard.status: CRITICAL FAIL (FAKE MCMASTER COTS, 0 CABLES, UNPLUMBED TOOLS)
key_failures: GATE-04 (Failure to Follow McMaster-Carr Import Instruction Across 68 STEP Files): Instead of importing real McMaster-Carr CAD models as instructed, the build script procedurally generated `threaded_shcs_m4..m8` with round cylindrical holes instead of 6-sided Allen hex sockets (`planes=5`), threadless M3/M4 bolts in `iso4762` & `iso9409`, 3-cylinder bearings (14 KB), and 2-box power modules (`0.35x` penalty).
